lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in four distinct horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity crossing the horizontal rows of blobs at regular intervals, forming a grid of intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal side to deep shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance spots across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, with higher density observed near the base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, irregularly shaped high-luminance patch is visible on the head, anterior to the first gill slit; the trailing edge of the first dorsal fin exhibits minor structural irregularities.
other_distinctive_markers: A remora is visible near the ventral posterior region, and a second smaller fish is positioned near the pelvic fin area; a human figure is visible in the upper background near the water surface.
